section_path: Malignant Melanoma of Other Eye (excluding Conjunctiva, Choroid, Ciliary Body, and Iris)
text:
C691  Cornea
C692  Retina
C695  Lacrimal gland
C698  Overlapping lesion of eye and adnexa
C699  Eye, NOS

**Note 1:**  Laterality must be coded for this site.

**Note 2:** This schema includes only melanomas of the sites listed above.

**Note 3:** TNM is not defined for this schema. If directly assigning Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000), use the *Melanoma of the Cornea, Retina, Choroid, Ciliary Body, Eyeball, and Overlapping and Other Eye* chapter on page 262 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=262).
